user.title: Grid statistics
user.description: The statistics that measure energy from and to the grid. They default to the Energy dashboard's grid source.

data_description.import_stat: Cumulative kWh imported from the grid.
data_description.export_stat: Cumulative kWh exported to the grid, if you have solar or storage.

utility.title: Utility account
utility.description: Compare against the usage your utility reports through Opower, and use its billing dates for the cycle.

data_description.enable_date_sensors: Opower disables its current-bill start and end date sensors by default. Enabling them lets cycles follow your real meter reads.

cycle.title: Billing cycle
cycle.description: Enter the day of the month your meter is read, or the end date of your last bill. Fill in one of them.

tariff.title: Rates
tariff.description: Your current rates. Leave both rates empty to check kWh only; you can add rates later.

data_description.supply: Generation/supply charge per kWh. Leave both rates empty to check kWh only.
data_description.tax_pct: Percent added to the whole bill.
data_description.export_rate: Credit per exported kWh, used with the separate-rate export mode.

reconfigure.title: Data sources
reconfigure.description: Changing a statistic discards the stored cycle history and rebuilds it from the new sources.

data_description.cycle_day: Used only when the date sensors are not set.

error.cycle_one: Enter either the meter-read day or the last bill end date.
error.cycle_pair: Set both billing-date sensors, or neither.
error.rates_both: Enter both the supply and the delivery rate.
error.invalid_tariff: The rates could not be read. Check the values and their format.

abort.already_configured: This meter is already being checked.

rates.title: Rates
rates.description: Saving replaces the rates starting on the same day, or adds a new version from that day. Tiers, seasonal rates and riders are kept.

data_description.supply: Generation/supply charge per kWh. Leave both rates empty to check kWh only.
data_description.tax_pct: Percent added to the whole bill.
data_description.export_rate: Credit per exported kWh, used with the separate-rate export mode.

rate_versions.title: Rate versions
rate_versions.description: Every rate version, as YAML. This is where tiers, seasonal rates and riders are set. An empty list removes the rates.

data_description.tolerance: How far the metered and utility kWh can differ before a cycle is flagged.

error.rates_both: Enter both the supply and the delivery rate.
error.invalid_tariff: The rates could not be read. Check the values and their format.

no_cycle.message: The current billing cycle is unknown: the utility's billing-date sensors are unavailable and no meter-read day is configured.

cycle_not_found.message: No closed billing cycle starts on {date}.

cycle_not_editable.message: This cycle's dates came from the utility and can't be edited.

invalid_dates.message: The end date must not be before the start date.

cycle_overlap.message: The new dates overlap another cycle or the current one. Shorten the neighbouring cycle first.

set_cycle_dates.name: Set cycle dates
set_cycle_dates.description: Corrects an estimated past cycle with the dates printed on the bill, then recomputes it.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The Check My Bill entry. Optional when there is only one.

cycle_start.name: Cycle
cycle_start.description: The start date the cycle has now.

start.name: Start
start.description: The first day of the billing period on the bill.

end.name: End
end.description: The last day of the billing period on the bill.

recompute.name: Recompute
recompute.description: Reads the statistics again for past cycles, for example after the utility imported late data.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The Check My Bill entry. Optional when there is only one.

cycle_start.name: Cycle
cycle_start.description: The start date of one cycle to recompute. Leave empty for all.

export_detected.title: Your utility is recording export
export_detected.description: {title} is set to export mode "none", but your utility is now recording energy sent to the grid. Check whether net metering started. If so, change the export mode under the integration's options (Settings). If the export is uncompensated, ignore this issue.

missing_statistic.title: A statistic used by Check My Bill is missing
missing_statistic.description: {title} uses statistics that no longer exist: {statistics}. This can happen after the utility integration is re-authenticated. Choose the new statistics with **Reconfigure** on the integration's entry.
